scripts.text:
[Cool Event Corp. Staff]
Welcome to Cool Event Corp.
Our staff is always working
to surpass your expactations
for quality service. So how
may I assist you today?
scripts.translation:
[酷活動公司職員]
歡迎光臨酷活動公司。
我們始終致力於提供超越您期待的優質服務。
今天有什麼可以幫您的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Cool Event Corp. Staff]
Your Respawn Point
has been saved here
{0}.
Thank you for using the
Cool Event Corp. service~
scripts.translation:
[酷活動公司職員]
您的復活點已保存於{0}。
感謝您使用酷活動公司的服務~

scripts.text:
[Cool Event Corp. Staff]
I'm sorry, but you
need the Novice's
Basic Skill Level 6 to
use the Storage Service.
scripts.translation:
[酷活動公司職員]
很抱歉，初心者的基本技能需要達到6級，才能使用倉庫服務。

scripts.text:
[Cool Event Corp. Staff]
I'm sorry, but you don't
have enough Zeny to use
the Storage Service. Our
Storage access fee is 40 Zeny.
scripts.translation:
[酷活動公司職員]
很抱歉，您的Zeny不足，
無法使用倉庫服務。
使用倉庫需要40 Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Cool Event Corp. Staff]
Let me open your personal
storage for you right away.
Thanks for supporting Cool
Event Corp. by using our
services. Have a good day~
scripts.translation:
[酷活動公司職員]
馬上為您打開個人倉庫。
感謝您使用我們的服務，支援酷活動公司。
祝您今天愉快~

scripts.text:
[Cool Event Corp. Staff]
I'm sorry, but you don't have
enough zeny for the Teleport
Service. The fee to teleport
to {0} is {1} zeny.
scripts.translation:
[酷活動公司職員]
很抱歉，您的Zeny不足，
無法使用瞬間移動服務。
傳送到{0}的費用是{1} Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Cool Event Corp. Staff]
I'm sorry, but the
Pushcart rental service
is only available to Merchant classes.
scripts.translation:
[酷活動公司職員]
很抱歉，手推車租賃服務僅對商人系職業開放。

scripts.text:
[Cool Event Corp. Staff]
I'm sorry, but the
Pushcart rental service
is only available to Merchants,
Blacksmiths, White Smiths,
Alchemists and Creators.
scripts.translation:
[酷活動公司職員]
很抱歉，手推車租賃服務僅對商人、鐵匠、神工匠、鍊金術士和創造者開放。

scripts.text:
[Cool Event Corp. Staff]
You can only rent a cart after
learning the Pushcart Skill.
scripts.translation:
[酷活動公司職員]
必須先學會手推車使用技能，才能租用手推車。

scripts.text:
[Cool Event Corp. Staff]
You already have
a Pushcart equipped.
Unfortunately, we can't
rent more than one to
each customer at a time.
scripts.translation:
[酷活動公司職員]
您已經有一輛手推車了。
很抱歉，每位顧客一次只能租用一輛。

scripts.text:
[Cool Event Corp. Staff]
The Pushcart rental
fee is 800 Zeny. Would
you like to rent a Pushcart?
scripts.translation:
[酷活動公司職員]
手推車租賃費是800 Zeny。
您要租用手推車嗎？

scripts.text:
[Cool Event Corp. Staff]
I'm sorry, but you
don't have enough
Zeny to pay the Pushcart
rental fee of 800 Zeny.
scripts.translation:
[酷活動公司職員]
很抱歉，您的Zeny不足，無法支付800 Zeny的手推車租賃費。

scripts.text:
[Cool Event Corp. Staff]
Cool Event Corp. is always
striving to provide the best
services for our customers.
Help us become the best by
providing us with your opinions
and honest feedback. Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[酷活動公司職員]
酷活動公司始終致力於為顧客提供最優質的服務。
歡迎提出意見，如實反饋，幫助我們做得更好。
謝謝。
